messages.author: 9fec238e3bf8496b
messages.subject: Debug output in org.renjin.sexp.Vector
parts: Currently DEBUG_ALLOC in org.renjin.sexp.Vector is defaulted to “true”. This can lead to a noisy STDOUT when working with large data. Should the default be false?

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Debug output in org.renjin.sexp.Vector
parts: Yes, sorry that is a mistake - it should only be set to true for debugging purposes while working on renjin. I would like to set this to an environment variable instead but I need to verify that the JVM will still treat it as effectively a constant as is now.
